urdu: کس پاکستانی صدر کے دور میں قراقرم یونیورسٹی کی بنیاد رکھی گئی تھی؟
english: During the tenure of which Pakistani president was the Karakoram University founded?
roman_1: Kis Pakistani sadar ke daur mein Karakoram University ki buniyaad rakhi gayi thi?
roman_2: Kis Pakistani sadr ke dor main Karakoram University ki buniyad rakhi gayi thi?
roman_3: Kis Pakistani sadar k daur may Karakoram University ki buniyaad rakhi gai thi?
